messages:
carla: scheduling a controlled v2 rollout in the 18:00 UTC change window. plan: 20% -> 10m -> 40% -> hold 20m. need final rollback criteria, pinlist changes, and deprecation blurb for header `X-Api-Version`.

nate: quick reminder: v2 enforces stricter schema and will return 400 for nullable->non-null changes. recommend `x-redwood-lax` gateway header for 48h as a temporary compatibility shim.

ops_li: alerting/rollback rules proposed: 5xx > 0.6% for 3m -> rollback; error-rate delta > 3x baseline for any tenant over 2m -> quarantine that tenant; p95 latency > 750ms for 2 consecutive 1m buckets -> suspend rollout. also want deploybot preflight smoke to pass before any expansion.

eva: adding docs note and customer-facing sample for migration. will open PR to docs with a clear deprecation schedule for `X-Api-Version` migration and a snippet to add header normalization. PR: https://go/docs/pr/2048

ryan: gateway case-normalize and `x-redwood-lax` toggle are staged and smoke green on staging. enabling gateway shim is fastest.

carla: deploybot, schedule toggle at 2025-07-02T18:00:00Z. monitor id r-1769991234. ensure preflight and smoke run before ramp.

deploybot: scheduled by carla at 2025-07-02T18:00:00Z. action: route /api -> v2 (initial 20%). monitor: r-1769991234. will run preflight and post-smoke checks.

ops_li: preflight passed. starting canary now.

deploybot: toggle started at 2025-07-02T18:00:00Z -> 20% to v2. preflight id pf-1769991234. will capture failures to s3://rollouts/r-1769991234/failed and tag traces with `rollout:r-1769991234`.

nate: seeing a tiny bump of validation errors from legacy clients (~0.02%). gateway-lax reduced noisy failures. capturing samples.

eva: updated release notes with migration guidance and a deprecation timeline: "We will remove the compatibility shim after 48h; upgrade clients to include proper schema types." Also added a short FAQ.

carla: decision: after 10m, if metrics stable, expand to 40%. ops_li confirm thresholds.

ops_li: metrics after 8m: p50 130ms, p95 210ms, 5xx 0.04%. healthy. but tenant t-771 shows 1.2% validation error -> should be auto-quarantined.

deploybot: tenant-quarantine triggered: t-771 pinned to v1 at 2025-07-02T18:08:21Z (event q-1769991234). notified account team.

nate: noted. adding t-771 to pinlist and notifying support.

carla: expanding to 40% now. keep gateway-lax for remainder of the 48h window. deploybot run?

deploybot: update: route -> 40% at 2025-07-02T18:10:12Z. monitoring r-1769991234. auto-rollback CLI configured below.

ryan: quick note: streaming clients might see chunk ordering changes in rare edge cases. added a known-issue to release notes recommending `stream=false` for older SDKs until patch.

carla: rollback CLI (ops_li please confirm):
```
# emergency rollback
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --monitor r-1769991234 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_li: verified. alerts wired to @eng-oncall and runbook linked. will auto-run rollback on configured thresholds and will announce before action.

eva: capturing final telemetry snapshot and will open a post-rollout ticket to review any pinned tenants and update docs.

deploybot: current status at 2025-07-02T18:16:00Z: partial route 40% to v2. tenant quarantine active. will not auto-ramp further without manual approval.

carla: thanks team. holding thread open for 1h to collect telemetry and follow up on any customer outreach. if rollback fires, use CLI above and ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
